rules.statement: A person may mortgage property of which he is not the owner at the date of the mortgage, whether that property consists of movables or immovables. When such a mortgage is effected, the first mortgage is preferential to any subsequent mortgage after the mortgagor had acquired ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Roman-Dutch Law a person may mortgage property of which he is not the owner at the date of the mortgage, whether that property consists of movables or immovables. When such a mortgage is effected, the first mortgage is preferential to any subsequent mortgage after the mortgagor had acquired ownership."
